item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera is doing a shadow activity at home in Jaipur. She places a torch on a table, holds a cardboard cut-out between the torch and a white wall, and observes the shadow on the wall. She then moves the cut-out closer to the torch, keeping the wall and torch in the same positions. What happens to the shadow on the wall?

options.A: The shadow becomes larger and its edges become less sharp.
options.B: The shadow becomes smaller and its edges become sharper.
options.C: The shadow becomes larger but its edges stay exactly as sharp as before.
options.D: The shadow does not change because only the object's shape decides the shadow's shape and size.
